events.title: 아스널 clinch the FA Premier League title with a 4–0 home win over 에버턴 . 맨체스터 시티 are relegated to Division Two, despite winning 5–2 at also-doomed 스토크 시티 . It is the first time in their history that they will be playing in the third tier of the English league. They are also the first former winners of a European trophy to be relegated to the third tier of their domestic league.
In their first game at the title triumph, 아스널 hit relegation form when 리버풀 beat them 4–0 at Anfield.

The FA Premier League season ends with 아스널 as champions and 맨체스터 유나이티드 as runners-up one point behind them, with both teams qualifying for the European Cup . The UEFA Cup places go to 리버풀 , 첼시 , 리즈 유나이티드 , 블랙번 로버스 and 애스턴 빌라 . 볼턴 원더러스 , 반즐리 and 크리스털 팰리스 are relegated. Bolton were the last team to go down – their 2–0 defeat at 첼시 meaning that a 1–1 draw with 코번트리 시티 at Goodison Park was enough to achieve survival on goal difference for 에버턴.

아스널 become the second English team (though with an entirely different set of players) to complete the 'double' when they beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 2–0 in the FA Cup final. Marc Overmars opens the scoring after 23 minutes, followed by 19-year-old 니콜라 아넬카 's goal in the 69th minute.
아스널 beats 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 2–0 to win the FA Cup , achieving The Double .
더비 카운티 pay a club record £2.7million for Argentine defender Horacio Carbonari from Rosario .
찰턴 애슬레틱 win promotion to the FA Premier League after beating 선덜랜드 7–6 on penalties following a 4–4 draw in the Division One playoff final.
